name: Adaptive Direct Volume Rendering for PVE Removal
aliases: Partial Volume Effect Removal via Adaptive Direct Volume Rendering
definition: A technique to remove partial volume artifacts (undesirable surfaces) at air-to-fluid transitions by combining iso-surface rendering with an intermediate direct volume rendering step, using a 2D Transfer Function (TF) based on intensity and gradient magnitude.
summary: This method removes partial volume artifacts at air-fluid transitions by combining iso-surface rendering with adaptive direct volume rendering based on surface-view angles and linear interpolation.
